entities.summary: Pallathur Venkatachalam Nandhidhaa is an Indian chess player from the state of Tamil Nadu, who holds the FIDE titles of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) and Woman International Master (WIM). She is the 17th Woman Grandmaster of India. Her peak FIDE ELO rating is 2380 and she is holding 9 International Master norms as of December 2025. She is the runner-up in World Junior Chess Championship in 2016. She won the women's edition of National Premier Chess Championship in both 2024 and 2025 consecutively.
